claim: Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc summit hike is a fairly steep 1.2 km path of about 1h30 round trip from the base car park, and the Sentier des Sources de la Loire is a separate easy 3 km circuit.
quote: The main route is approximately 1.2 km long and requires 1 hour 30 minutes round trip on a fairly steep path. ... The Sentier des Sources de la Loire is a pleasant 3 km walk exploring where the Loire River originates.

claim: Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc peaks at 1551 m and is best visited after snowmelt and bloom; the path is impassable in rain/storm because the trachyte stones turn slippery.
quote: Altitude: 1,551 meters (peak elevation) ... The guide recommends visiting after snow melts and when flowers begin to bloom ... impossible during rain or thunderstorms due to slippery stones.

claim: Mont Mézenc loop from Croix de Peccata is 6.4 km with about 260 m elevation gain, around 2h35, moderate difficulty, reaching the 1747 m summit ridge.
quote: Distance & Duration: 3.98 mi taking approximately 2 hours and 35 minutes ... The trail climbs 856 feet ... The highest point reaches 5,732 feet ... Rated as moderate difficulty ... Starting Location: Parking at Croix de Peccata

claim: Mont Mézenc is the highest peak in the Ardèche at 1753 m (south summit) / 1744 m (north), with a 360° panorama from the Alps to the Puy de Dôme; the standard ascent from the Croix des Boutières car park takes about two hours round trip in summer.
quote: Located at the altitude of 1753 m (5751 feet) for the South Summit, and 1744 m (5722 feet) for the North Summit ... The ascent of Mézenc is easily completed in two hours round trip in the summer, from the Croix des Boutières car park.

claim: Lac de Devesset has an easy 3.5 km loop trail around it, suitable for families on foot or by bike, with supervised swimming only in July–August.
quote: A scenic trail encircles the lake at approximately 3.5 km, noted as an easy walk, accessible to all ... supervised swimming and water sports only operate in the summer (July-August).

claim: Lac de Devesset is a 51-hectare reservoir on the Haut-Vivarais plateau at 1074 m altitude, max depth 10.5 m, dam completed in 1974.
quote: The lake is at 1,074 m altitude ... Its surface area is 51 hectares ... Its maximum depth is 10.5 m (measured in 2011) ... located on the Haut-Vivarais plateau ... The dam was completed in 1974

claim: Mont Chiniac at 1116 m is the easy family belvédère above Saint-Agrève, reachable via the 6 km 'Chante-coucou' loop (+123 m) through the Forêt de la Rèche.
quote: Altitude: 1,116 meters ... The 'Chante-coucou' family hike is described as suitable for families ... Accès libre (free access) year-round ... un point de vue circulaire at the summit with orientation tables

claim: The Chante-coucou loop from Saint-Agrève up Mont Chiniac is a 6 km family hike with 123 m of climb that ends on the Velay / Boutières belvédère.
quote: Cette balade de 6 km et 123 m D+ à faire en famille vous conduira sur le belvédère de la chaîne du Velay et des sucs des Boutières.

claim: The Lignon gorges between Tence and Le Chambon-sur-Lignon are dotted with viewpoints (Moulin de Boyer, Sauron, Beaujeu, Pont de Mars, Pont de Salettes) and six marked PR loops; the upper Lignon is at its wildest near Mazet-Saint-Voy.
quote: Six marked trails available: Pèlerins, Plateau, Pont de Mars, Beaujeu, Papeterie, and Joux circuits. ... 1. Moulin de Boyer (Mazet-Saint-Voy) - wild Lignon near its source

claim: The Haut-Lignon network offers 24 PR loops over ~240 km, including easy options (PR034 Beaujeu 7 km, PR038 Pèlerins 4.9 km) and harder routes (PR033 Lizieux 15.5 km, PR040 Roche druidique 12.8 km).
quote: 24 PR (Promenade & Randonnées) trails totaling approximately 240 km ... PR034 Le Mas de Tencou (Le Mas-de-Tence): 1.7 km, 40 minutes ... PR033 Le circuit du Lizieux (Mazet-Saint-Voy): 15.5 km, 4h 15min

claim: Crêt de l'Oeillon (1364 m) is the second highest summit of the Pilat, with a panorama from the Trois Dents over the Rhône valley as far as the Vercors, Écrins and Mont-Blanc on clear days.
quote: Crêt de l'Oeillon is the second most remarkable summit of the Pilat, standing 1,364 meters above sea level ... on a clear day you can see the Vercors mountains, the Ecrins, and the Mont-Blanc range.

claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid to Les Estables (foot of Mont Mézenc) is roughly 53 km by the scenic cycling route via Mars / Saint-Agrève / Col de la Croix de Peccata (1570 m), implying ~50 minutes by direct car.
quote: The route covers 53,47 km with 1046 m of elevation gain ... via Saint Agrève before tackling the significant climb toward Mont Mézenc ... col de la Croix de Peccata at 1,570 meters

claim: Lalouvesc at 1100 m sits on the junction of the GR420 and GR430 and offers 22+ marked walks, including the 6 km / ~2 h Tour du Mont Chaix loop with Alpine views.
quote: Lalouvesc (at an altitude of 1,100 metres) is the meeting point of the GR® 420 and 430 trails ... More than 22 walks, hikes and thematic trails ... Le tour du Mont Chaix is a hiking circuit ... approximately 6 kilometres represents an average of 2 hours of walking

claim: Les Estables (the village at the foot of Mont Mézenc, with the Croix des Boutières / Peccata trailheads) is less than 30 minutes from Le Puy-en-Velay, confirming snow is the limiting factor since it doubles as a small ski station.
quote: Les Estables, the nearby ski resort at the foot of Mont Mézenc, is less than 30 minutes from Le Puy-en-Velay

claim: The 268 m Passerelle Himalayenne over the Lignon (France's longest, opened April 2022) is accessed from Grazac (5.4 km, +176 m) or Saint-Maurice-de-Lignon (7.7 km, +215 m) — sits in the lower Lignon, ~45 km from Saint-Bonnet so just beyond the 30 km radius.
quote: The Himalayan footbridge is 268.5 m long and 78 m high above the Lignon ... from Grazac (5.4 kilometers round trip with an elevation gain of +176 meters, very easy access) or from Saint-Maurice-de-Lignon (7.7 kilometers, 215 meters of elevation gain)

claim: Lieu de Mémoire au Chambon opens daily except Monday 10h-12h30 and 14h-18h from 2 May to 30 Sep; low-season Wed-Sat 14h-18h; full price €5 (€7 during temporary exhibitions), reduced €3.
quote: haute saison (2 mai - 30 septembre) : tous les jours, sauf le lundi : de 10h à 12h30 et de 14h à 18h ... Plein tarif : 5 € (7 € en période d'exposition temporaire) ... Tarif réduit : 3 € (5 € en période d'exposition)

claim: The Lieu de Mémoire reopened 4 March 2026 with a temporary exhibition on the end of the Shoah 1944-1948, running through 31 May 2026.
quote: Le Lieu de mémoire du Chambon-sur-Lignon rouvrira ses portes le 4 mars avec une expo sur la Shoah ... la fin de la Shoah de 1944 à 1948 ... jusqu'au 31 mai

claim: Le Chambon and surrounding Plateau Vivarais-Lignon villages (pop. ~24,000) sheltered about 3,000-3,500 Jews from 1940 to 1944, led by Pastor André Trocmé.
quote: the inhabitants of the French village of Le Chambon-sur-Lignon (population 5,000) and the villages on the surrounding plateau (population 24,000) provided refuge for an estimated 5,000 people, including about 3,000–3,500 Jews

claim: In 1990 Yad Vashem collectively honored Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and surrounding communes as Righteous Among the Nations — one of only two collective tributes ever awarded.
quote: the people of Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and the neighboring communes ... A plaque on the Yad Vashem grounds was unveiled in 1990 to commemorate

claim: Musée des Papeteries Canson & Montgolfier (700 rue de Vidalon, Davézieux near Annonay) opens Wed & Sun 14h30-18h year-round, daily 14h15-18h in July-Aug; adult €6.50, child 6-16 €5.
quote: Mercredi & Dimanche, 14h30-18h ... Du 1er juillet au 31 août : tous les jours, 14h15-18h ... Plein tarif : 6,50 € ... 6 à 16 ans : 5 €

claim: Musée Saint-Régis in Lalouvesc opens daily from 30 March to 9 November 2026 with free admission; the diorama in 19 painted scenes by Georges Serraz depicts the saint's life.
quote: From 30/03 to 09/11/2026 every day ... Free participation ... a diorama in 19 paintings by the artist Georges Serraz

claim: The Basilique Saint-Régis at Lalouvesc, built 1865-1877, houses the relics of Jesuit Jean-François Régis and (since 2018) of Sainte Thérèse Couderc.
quote: La basilique Saint-Régis de Lalouvesc est un édifice religieux catholique construit entre 1865 et 1877 ... abrite les reliques de saint Jean-François Régis, l'apôtre du Vivarais, mort à Lalouvesc

claim: The École Nationale Supérieure de la Pâtisserie (ENSP), founded 1984 by Yves Thuriès and Alain Ducasse, occupies the 19th-century Château de Montbarnier in Yssingeaux.
quote: L'ENSP est installée dans le château de Montbarnier ... créée en 1984 par Yves Thuriès et Alain Ducasse

claim: Yssingeaux's Hôtel de Ville is a 15th-century fortified former summer residence built by Jean de Bourbon, bishop of Le Puy, on Place du Général-de-Gaulle, open only by guided tour.
quote: Bishop Jean of Bourbon, bishop at Puy-en-Velay, built a summer residence for the prelates. It was built as a true fortress ... open only for guided tours

claim: Château d'Artias at Retournac, perched on a pyramidal rock, is a freely accessible medieval ruin with eco-museum, botanical garden and bailiff's house; allow ~1h30.
quote: Le château d'Artias ... accès libre ... maison d'accueil avec de nombreux objets médiévaux ... un jardin botanique ... Prévoir 1h30 pour la visite

claim: Tence offers a Pénitents Blancs chapel-museum (open July-Aug Wed-Sat, otherwise by reservation) and a small Museum of Pharmacy, set among four bell towers.
quote: the Pénitents Blancs chapel-museum ... open in July and August ... Museum of Pharmacy, open in July and August Thursdays

claim: Le Chambon-sur-Lignon lies 20.4 km / ~18 minutes by road from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid; Annonay is ~28 km / ~29 minutes.
quote: Distance Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid Le Chambon-sur-Lignon : 20,4 km en voiture, 18 min

claim: Safari de Peaugres 2026 adult ticket €29.90 (11+), child €25.50 (3-10), under 3 free; ~4+ hour visit with 5 km drive-through safari (1h) plus minimum 3 hour walking section across 80 ha with 1,200 animals.
quote: Adulte (11+) : 29,90 € ... Enfant (3-10 ans) : 25,50 €. Circuit safari en voiture: 5 km circuit covering one hour across two continents. Walking section: Minimum 3 hours.

claim: Safari de Peaugres operates April–September daily 10:00–18:30 (9:30–19:00 in July-August), with low-season limited days (Fri-Sun in Jan-Feb plus school holidays).
quote: Avril à septembre, ouverture tous les jours de 10h à 18h30 (9h30 à 19h en juillet-août). Basse saison: vendredis et week-ends plus tous les jours pendant les vacances scolaires.

claim: Driving distance from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid to Peaugres is roughly 36 km / 40 minutes — just outside the 30 km radius but easy day trip.
quote: La distance pour aller de Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid à Peaugres est de 36 kilomètres et le trajet dure 40 minutes.

claim: Velay Express 2026 runs Sundays and May public holidays May-October, plus Wednesdays and Thursdays from 16 July to 31 August; route stops at Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and Saint-Agrève (Dunières section closed since 2015).
quote: De mai à octobre les dimanches et pont de mai. Du 16 juillet au 31 août les mercredis et jeudis. Gares: Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon, Saint-Agrève.

claim: Velay Express 2026 tickets: adult €16.50–€22.50, child (4-12) €13.50–€19.50, family (2A+2C) €54–€78, under 4 free on lap; both steam (vapeur) and diesel (autorail) trains operate the heritage Galoche line.
quote: Adulte: 16,50€ à 22,50€. Enfant (4-12 ans): 13,50€ à 19,50€. Famille (2 adultes + 2 enfants): 54€ à 78€. Train à vapeur ... à bord d'un train d'autrefois.

claim: Lac de Devesset access fees: €2 visitor, €3 for 2-wheelers, €5 for cars (last two weekends of June, July, August, first two weekends of September); free outside that window.
quote: Free for residents, €2 for visitors, €3 for 2-wheelers (until 6 PM), €5 for 4-wheelers, €2 after 4 PM. Vehicle access paid during last two weekends of June, July and August.

claim: Parcours Acrobatiques des Sucs in Yssingeaux (440 chemin de Rachessac, 43200) offers four colour-graded courses (yellow from age 3), two ziplines and a 20 m bungy ejection; 3-hour session pricing €7 (ages 3-6), €15 (7-10), €20 (10+).
quote: Yellow course: Ages 3-6 (€7). Green/blue/tyrolienne 1: Ages 7-10 or 1.20m+ (€15). Red/tyrolienne 2: Ages 10+ or 1.40m+ (€20). 440 chemin de Rachessac, 43200 Yssingeaux.

claim: Parcours Acrobatique des Sucs opens 30 April–20 September 2026 by reservation, daily 10:00–18:30.
quote: Le parc est ouvert du 30 avril 2026 au 20 septembre 2026, mais uniquement sur réservation. Tous les jours de 10h00 à 18h30.

claim: NaturaLoisirs (9 rue du Velay, Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid) rents electric and standard bikes (Giant partner), open Thu-Sun in spring (10-19h), Wed-Sun July-September.
quote: Location et vente de vélo (Giant). Apr-Jun: Thursday-Sunday, 10am-7pm. Jul-Sep: Wednesday-Sunday, 10am-7pm. 9 Rue du Velay, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.

claim: Les Marraignes asinerie in Saint-Agrève (Ardèche, ~15 km from Saint-Bonnet) offers donkey-accompanied walks, farm visits, brushing and feeding; school-holiday sessions Tue-Thu 10:00-11:30 and Fri 16:30-18:00, capacity 50.
quote: Commune: Saint-Agrève. Donkey visits and encounters. Weekdays (Tuesday-Thursday): 10:00-11:30 AM. Fridays: 4:30-6:00 PM. Capacity: Limited to 50 people per visit.

claim: Les Marraignes donkey hikes start from €15; one packed donkey covers 3-4 adults for a full day, with 30 min briefing on handling before departure; asinerie visits free with optional donation.
quote: Hikes with donkeys start from €15. For a full day hike, one donkey is sufficient for 3 or even 4 adults. Approximately 30 minutes instruction on handling. Free admission to asinerie, donations welcome.

claim: Parc Family Aventure at La Séauve-sur-Semène (43140) — eastern Haute-Loire, beyond the 30 km radius — offers 17 accrobranche courses, escape game, giant pendulum jump and treehouses; Initiation pack €12 (age 3+), Discovery €15 (age 4+).
quote: Plan d'eau / Base de loisirs - lieu dit Vaujalat, 43140, La Séauve-sur-Semène. INITIATION €12 per person for 4 green courses (ages 3+, max 1h30). DISCOVERY €15 for 9 courses with giant zipline.

claim: Bistrot la Coulemelle (Marcon bistrot) is at Rue du Vivarais, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid, open Thursday to Monday (closed Tue/Wed), 50 seats, Bib Gourmand.
quote: Adresse: Rue du Vivarais 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid... Ouvert du jeudi au lundi, Fermé mardi et mercredi... Capacité: 50 places... BIB Gourmand

claim: The Marcon family ecosystem in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid includes a gastronomic restaurant, family bistrot, Bar de Païs, La Chanterelle bakery, Relais & Châteaux hotel, gîtes d'étape, Spa du Haut Plateau, cooking school and a shop.
quote: Restaurants & Dining: Gastronomic restaurant, Family bistrot, Bar de Païs... Bakery: La Chanterelle... Hotels (Relais Château and Logis de France 3-star)... Spa du Haut Plateau... Cooking school... Shop/Boutique

claim: Cave (Vins) Marcon at 46 rue du Velay sells fine wines, local products and beers, open Mon-Sat 9-12:30/14:30-19 and Sun/holidays 9:30-12:30/15-19, with group tastings by appointment.
quote: 46, rue du Velay, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid... Monday-Saturday: 9:00-12:30, 14:30-19:00; Sunday & holidays: 9:30-12:30, 15:00-19:00... Vins fins, boissons, bières spéciales, produits locaux... Dégustations de groupes sur rendez-vous

claim: Cave Marcon partnered with distiller Bérenger Mayoux in Solignac-sur-Loire to launch their own artisanal liqueur 'La Grande Verveine', using verbena from Jacques Marcon's gardens.
quote: La Cave Marcon lance sa propre liqueur artisanale, la Grande Verveine... partenariat avec Bérenger Mayoux, distillateur à Solignac-sur-Loire... la verveine provient des jardins de Jacques Marcon

claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid's Foire aux Champignons is scheduled for 7-8 November 2026 — not relevant for a May visit but confirms the village's mushroom identity.
quote: La prochaine foire aux champignons aura lieu les 7 et 8 novembre 2026

claim: Yssingeaux has three markets: Thursday 7-13h (producers/regional), a Saturday bovine fair 12-19h, and a Sunday producer market 7-13h.
quote: marché de producteurs le dimanche de 7h à 13h, une foire bovins le samedi de 12h à 19h, et un marché le jeudi de 7h à 13h

claim: Saint-Agrève holds its weekly market on Monday mornings 8-13h at Place Félise d'Asseyne, plus a Thursday evening producer market 17-19h from May to September.
quote: Le marché de Saint-Agrève se tient toute l'année, tous les lundis de 8h à 13h... un marché de producteurs locaux a lieu du 21 mai au 17 septembre 2026 le jeudi entre 17h et 19h

claim: Annonay's Saturday market runs 8:00-13:15 at Place de la Liberté/Rue Montgolfier with all types of commerce; main market days are Wednesday and Saturday, with no Sunday market in Annonay itself but a Sunday market 7-12:30 at neighbouring Boulieu-lès-Annonay.
quote: Saturday market runs from 8:00 AM to 1:15 PM at Place de la Liberté and Rue Montgolfier... Annonay market operates on Wednesdays and Saturdays only... market in Boulieu-lès-Annonay every Sunday from 7:00 AM to 12:30 PM

claim: The closest Sunday market to Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is Lalouvesc (~9-10 km), 7-13h, with Devesset (Wed) and Montfaucon-en-Velay (Tue) as other weekday options.
quote: In Lalouvesc (approximately 9-10 kilometers from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid), there is a market on Sundays from 7am to 1pm... Devesset: Wednesday market from 8am to 1pm... Montfaucon-en-Velay: Tuesday market

claim: Tence (~15 km from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid) holds its weekly market on Tuesday mornings only (7-12h), Boulevard Léon Rocher / Place du Chatiague — no regular weekend market.
quote: The market in Tence takes place Tuesday mornings year-round... Boulevard Léon Rocher, Place du Chatiague, 43190 Tence... 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM on Tuesdays

claim: Fourme de Montbrison AOP is made by 7 dairies (3 industrial + 4 farmhouse) using cow's milk from 33 Haut-Forez communes above 700 m altitude, with several producers open for visits and farm shops.
quote: The milk is transformed by 7 fromageries (3 dairy and 4 farmhouse producers), open for visits throughout the year... cow's milk collected from 33 communes of Haut Forez at over 700 meters altitude

claim: Fromagerie Artisanale des Hautes Chaumes in Sauvain (Monts du Forez, Loire) produces Fourme de Montbrison AOP, tommes and tommettes, founded 1999 by Hubert Tarit with input from MOF Hervé Mons.
quote: Founded in 1999 by Hubert TARIT in Sauvain in Monts du Forez (Loire, 42), with expertise from Hervé Mons, Meilleur Ouvrier de France, they produce artisanal cheeses including the emblematic Fourme de Montbrison AOP

claim: Picodon AOP is a goat-milk cheese from Ardèche and Drôme; the AOP body maintains a producer map with farms offering direct sales and farm visits, many open seasonally.
quote: Les producteurs de Picodon AOP | Carte et adresses... vente directe... visite à la ferme

claim: Lentille Verte du Puy AOP (since 2008, the first European pulse to obtain AOP) is grown 600-1,200 m altitude on volcanic soils across 87 Velay communes, with producers like David Vigouroux (Saint-Haon) and Myriam Rivet.
quote: 1ère légumineuse européenne à avoir obtenu une AOP... entre 600 et 1 200 m d'altitude sur 87 communes et sur des sols à dominante volcanique

claim: Châtaigne d'Ardèche AOP covers 118 Ardèche communes (Saint-Agrève included) plus 7 Gard + 2 Drôme, with the comité interprofessionnel listing producteurs-transformateurs open to visitors and a Maison du Châtaignier at Saint-Pierreville.
quote: L'AOP Châtaigne d'Ardèche couvre 118 communes de l'Ardèche, 7 du Gard et 2 de la Drôme... Saint-Agrève est notamment une des communes incluses... La Maison du châtaignier est située à Saint-Pierreville

claim: The Saint-Joseph AOC stretches along the right bank of the Rhône through Mauves and Tournon — about 50 km / 52 min drive from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid (just outside the 30 km radius but reachable as a day-trip), and the Doux river from Saint-Bonnet flows down to the 'Sainte-Épine' terroir within the appellation.
quote: The Doux river takes its source at Saint-Bonnet and descends the beautiful Ardèche slopes down to 'Sainte-Épine,' one of the greatest terroirs of the appellation

claim: Tournon-sur-Rhône (heart of Saint-Joseph wine tourism) is ~50 km / 52 min by car from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.
quote: The distance between Tournon-sur-Rhône and Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is 41 miles, with a road distance of 31 miles... The fastest way to get from Tournon-sur-Rhône to Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is to drive which takes 52 min

claim: Lalouvesc is roughly 13.6 km / 14 min by car from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid via the D532.
quote: La distance à parcourir est calculée à 13,6 kilomètres ... Le trajet en voiture entre Lalouvesc et Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid prend 14 minutes.

claim: Yssingeaux is approximately 32 km / 29 min driving from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.
quote: distance Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid et Yssingeaux ... 20 miles ... 29 minutes

claim: Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc sits about 37 km from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid, just outside the 30-km radius but reachable in roughly an hour of mountain D-road driving.
quote: Distance Mont gerbier de jonc (07) ... 37 km

claim: Lalouvesc is a hilltop sanctuary village at near 1100 m altitude with views over the Cevennes and Alps, anchored by the 19th-century Basilica Saint-Regis.
quote: Lalouvesc is a village in the Ardèche at almost 1100m altitude with beautiful views over the mountains of the Cévennes and the Alps

claim: Annonay's Canson & Montgolfier paper-mill museum is set in the Montgolfier brothers' birthplace and runs guided demonstrations of 17th-21st-century paper-making.
quote: The paper mill museum is in the house where the Montgolfier brothers (inventors of the hot-air balloon) were born. It brings 17th-21st century paper milling to life

claim: Le Chambon-sur-Lignon sits at 874-1139 m on the Vivarais-Lignon plateau and is the only French village awarded the Righteous Among the Nations title collectively; its Lieu de Memoire museum is open March-November.
quote: Le Chambon-sur-Lignon ... Situated between 874 and 1,139 m above sea level ... the only village in France to have been awarded the title of "Righteous Among the Nations"

claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid has a temperate oceanic (Cfb) climate, with May the wettest month at about 13.7 rainy days and ~1127 mm of annual precipitation.
quote: The climate here is classified as Cfb by the Köppen-Geiger ... The wettest month is May (13.73 days) ... 1127 mm | 44.4 inch

claim: The Velay Express line currently links Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and Saint-Agreve; the former extension to Dunieres was closed in 2015.
quote: 4 stations: Raucoules, Tence, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon and Saint-Agrève ... the line was previously operated up to Dunières, but this section was closed in 2015

claim: The road to Mont Mezenc is not cleared in winter and best visited February-November; late-spring snow can still affect the summit road into May.
quote: The road to Mont Mézenc is not cleared of snow or salt during winter periods, requiring chains or good tires, and the best times to visit the trail are February through November
